event_summary: A colorful teapot-shaped object on a black circular base steadily rotated on a tabletop while its mirror reflection changed accordingly.
raw_event_description: The scene shows a blue teapot-shaped object with red handle and spout, yellow trim, and floral patterns standing on a black circular base on a wooden tabletop near a mirror. From the start through the end, the teapot-shaped object changes orientation around its vertical axis: the red spout and handle move through different visible positions, while the base remains in the same location on the table. The mirror on the right shows a reflected view of the same rotating teapot-shaped object. The cord lying on the tabletop and the surrounding walls and furniture remain visually stationary.

reasons: The main teapot-shaped object, base, tabletop, cord, wall, and mirror are visible.
The object is already present in the scene at the start, with no separate visible onset.
